## Verification

<!-- List the exact checks run and any validation that remains intentionally gated. -->

- [ ] The change is focused and contains no unrelated generated files.
- [ ] Tests cover changed behavior, or the reason tests are not applicable is explained.
- [ ] User-facing behavior and operational changes are documented.
- [ ] Fixtures, logs, screenshots, and prose contain no credentials, personal data, raw messages, or private AWS account details.
- [ ] Commits include a Developer Certificate of Origin sign-off.
